name: School Bus Conduct Report
description: Report of a student infraction on a school vehicle (name, grade, bus, date, run, conduct), emailed to the principal and Transportation Office to start an investigation.
recipient: School principal and/or designee; District Transportation Office
deadline: as soon as possible; for PM-run incidents, no later than the conclusion of the driver's AM run the following day
quote: The bus driver contractor will then email a copy of the report to the school principal and/or designee and the District’s Transportation Office.
